ChildProfile.title: ChildProfile
ChildProfile.description: Stores the child's learning profile, selected avatar, total earned stars, daily streak, and completed quiz count.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase Auth UID owning this profile.

totalStars.description: Cumulative stars earned across lessons and quizzes.

completedQuizzes.description: Total number of completed quizzes and spelling games.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of profile creation (clients submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile update (clients submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

MasteredWord.title: MasteredWord
MasteredWord.description: Records an English letter, number, or vocabulary word mastered by the child.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase Auth UID owning this record.

wordId.description: Curriculum identifier of the learned item.

starsEarned.description: Stars awarded for mastering this word.

masteredAt.description: Server timestamp when the word was mastered (clients submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

QuizSession.title: QuizSession
QuizSession.description: Records the result of a completed listening quiz or spelling game session.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase Auth UID owning this session.

starsEarned.description: Total stars earned in this session.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of session completion (clients submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Stores each signed-in family's child learning profile and aggregate progress.

/users/{userId}/masteredWords/{wordId}.description: Stores letters and words mastered by the child.

/users/{userId}/quizSessions/{sessionId}.description: Stores completed quiz and spelling game history.
